name: Toncenter (TON blockchain HTTP API v3)
operator: Toncenter (public TON blockchain API run by the TON Core team)
tier_rationale: Public, documented TON blockchain API operated by the TON Core team since 2019 with published rate limits and API keys issued through @tonapibot; council decision P214 cond 4 'Registry provider toncenter: tier community, terms open' (A8 community).

reliability.justification: Indexes public TON blockchain state: authoritative for balances, transactions and current NFT ownership at query time; NFT ownership can change at any time and the indexer can lag.

error_markers.reason: Toncenter: rate limit exceeded ({'ok': false, 'code': 429}; keyless 1 request/s)

toncenter.description: Toncenter API key (X-API-Key header, never in a URL): raises the keyless 1 request/s limit to 10 requests/s
toncenter.plan_hint: a team key issued by @tonapibot to a company/team Telegram account (never a personal account)

api_v3.title: Toncenter API v3: walletInformation, transactions, nft/items, nft/transfers, masterchainInfo

terms.quote: Registry provider toncenter: tier community, terms open (council-1 P214 cond 4, binding council text; free public API, keyless 1 request per second, a free key from @tonapibot raises it to 10).

api_v3.notes: Quote: binding council text (P214 cond 4); research C0495 verified_live 200 (2026-11-26, masterchainInfo, nft/collections, nft/items, nft/transfers, walletInformation, transactions). 409 {'error': 'not a wallet'} for contract addresses; 422 'failed to decode' for malformed addresses; {'nft_items': []} for an unminted index. Collectible lookups send the decimal sha256 of the Telegram username/number (Telemint item index): treat it as disclosing the identifier (P214 cond 2-3). Used by ton_explorer.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G09-1 (P214). On-chain resolution goes through Toncenter only; tonapi.io and api.getgems.io stay held (P214 cond 4, A8). Politeness is set by the module: 1.1 s keyless, 0.11 s with the key. personal_data_review pending: the module is default_enabled=False and phone/username lookups need an explicit selection with --purpose (POL-07).
